test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

I had only my class notes **__for which I had to__** prepare for my examination.
solution:
The correct answer is** "with which I had to."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the correct verb form is **"had."**
 
• **"Only" **emphasizes that the speaker had nothing else to use.
 
• **"Class notes"** is the correct term for the notes taken during a class.
 
• **"With which"** is the correct preposition to use with **"notes."**
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

**Correct sentence: ***I had only my class notes **with which I had**__ to prepare for my examination. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"From whom"** is incorrect because notes are not a person.
 
• **"In which I have to"** is incorrect because it uses the present tense instead of the past tense.
